The '''Mining Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked in the {{LI|Coal}} collection, with upgraded tiers being able to hold a higher capacity of mining-related items. The Beginner Sack can only hold vanilla resources, and the Large Enchanted Mining Sack can hold enchanted versions of items. 

== Obtaining ==
=== Merchant ===
A '''Beginner Mining Sack''' can be bought for {{c|250}} at {{NPCSprite|Mining Merchant}} in the [[Hub]] near {{Zone|Mining District}}.
